# Deal Progression Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Deal Progression Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template:** an example to modify for your requirements; the customer or partner wires it into their environment. See the [Overview](1.Overview.md).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Details | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build workload | 22 captured build checkpoints; 6 skills; 2 knowledge files; 6 acceptance checks; 6 locked cases. [Inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components), [checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks), and [cases](4.Sample-prompts.md#demo-prompts). | Template |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm tenant licensing and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness; building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication. | Customer or partner |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved environment, publisher prefix and maker access; confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available and keep the build Draft. | Customer or partner |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review policies for uploaded pipeline files, the proposed CRM and playbook sources and the channel; document blocked paths instead of bypassing them. | Customer or partner |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always trigger; record who may build, test and use the agent. | Customer or partner |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for Dynamics 365 Sales, the SharePoint playbook library and Microsoft Teams; the workshop needs no connection. | Customer or partner |
| Test identities | Prepare account executive, sales director and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment; makers use Draft Preview. | Customer or partner |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: Copilot Studio in the browser. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer. | Customer or partner |
| Approval ownership | Name the sales leaders and opportunity owners who approve tasks, forecasts and communications, plus required specialist reviewers. | Customer or partner |

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales leadership owner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist).

**Measure:** Pipeline-review effort and stalled-deal evidence by stage. Agree how pipeline views are reconciled today before attributing any change to the adapted agent.

Fill your baseline record:

| Stage | Measurement period | Open opportunities | Stalled opportunities | Documented blocker | Review effort |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |

Agree data sources, benchmarks, playbooks, governance, support, telemetry and success measures.

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales leadership owner

Adapt [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract); assign approval roles.

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Sales leadership owner | Approve scope, benchmarks, playbooks and success measures; never treat synthetic scenarios as pipeline or revenue. |
| Opportunity owners and specialist reviewers | Review every task, owner, deadline, forecast implication and communication; legal, finance, pricing and customer-success review apply where needed. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and six skills; remove web search, confirm the model and keep the agent Draft. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm licensing, capacity, environment access, authenticated audience and data policies before sales data is connected. |
| Sales data connection owners | Approve dedicated Dynamics 365 Sales, SharePoint and Microsoft Teams references and their identities; own access failures. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check DP-01 through DP-06 and the boundary tests on full responses; reject blank and reshoot-required captures. |
| Operations owner | Own session and credit monitoring, support and configuration recovery; route pipeline actions to opportunity owners. |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures are agreed with named owners.
- [ ] Sales leadership records current pipeline-review effort and stalled-deal evidence before choosing success measures.

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Approve the identity and settings design

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Review and approve the [identity design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and [template settings](../../solutions/deal-progression/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml). Apply agent-specific settings when the agent is built in [Phase 2](#phase-2--build-and-prove-the-agent).

Approve file, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Approve the environment, audience and connection identities. Define the [authentication plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication); configure environment [data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The approved environment and maker access are recorded, and the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available there.
- [ ] Authenticated seller access and only the necessary opportunity scopes are approved.

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Choose the build lane

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted authoring | Synthetic Draft proof |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Browser-only makers | Same Draft proof |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Portable learning | Behavior proof; native validation follows |

[Compare lanes](1.Overview.md#delivery-lanes); local Brainstem remains optional.

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

**Easy mode:** use the [authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and [reviewed messages](../../solutions/deal-progression/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md). **Manual:** use the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components) and [tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/deal-progression/manual-tutorial.html) with the checklist below. **Portable learning:** follow [deployment.json](../../solutions/deal-progression/deployment.json); it does not replace native Draft validation.

**Manual build checklist** — [captured sequence](../../solutions/deal-progression/screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json). Record current results.

1. Create a blank Copilot Studio agent
2. Name Deal Progression Manual
3. Enter the reviewed global instructions
4. Save the instruction policy
5. Remove default web search
6. Add knowledge: aibast_deal-progression-operating-rules.md
7. Add knowledge: aibast_deal-progression-synthetic-records.md
8. Add skill: acceleration
9. Add skill: action-plans
10. Add skill: assign-tasks
11. Add skill: executive-summary
12. Add skill: pipeline-health
13. Add skill: stalled-deals
14. Review model, skills, knowledge, and safety boundaries
15. Open a fresh Preview conversation
16. Pass DP-01: Sales Director
17. Pass DP-02: Account Executive
18. Pass DP-03: Account Executive
19. Pass DP-04: Sales Director
20. Pass DP-05: Sales Director
21. Pass DP-06: Sales Director
22. Confirm Draft and stop before publish

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Apply the [workshop integrity and recovery rules](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) before replay.

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** record every locked case: DP-01, DP-02, DP-03, DP-04, DP-05, DP-06. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The chosen lane's Preview evidence identifies the agent, model, inventory and Draft state.
- [ ] If the portable lane is used, the smoke test calls `DealProgressionAgent` and returns its required markers.
- [ ] The manual build has reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, six skills and the confirmed model; web search and tools are absent.
- [ ] Each unchanged locked prompt passes once in a separate fresh conversation on the owned Draft.
- [ ] Each case passes on the full final response; an annotated screenshot does not replace the machine gate.

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

<a id="shared-integration-controls"></a>

**Shared identity and scope controls**

For each integration, decide end-user versus approved maker/service credentials. [Configure authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) for the [authorized audience](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions).

**Shared scope:** Require sign-in before opportunity data is reachable. Request only read scopes for the six review skills. Restrict the seller audience and test authorized and denied identities. Enforce these restrictions at each connection.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Dynamics 365 Sales

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales data connection owners

1. **Bind Dynamics 365 Sales — read:** Add approved Dataverse tables as knowledge or bind read-only actions; no stage, forecast or task write.

2. **Identity for Dynamics 365 Sales:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Dynamics 365 Sales:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Dynamics 365 Sales:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 3](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Send nothing; keep the playbook step as a draft for the opportunity owner. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Say it is not present in the fixed snapshot; never invent or substitute.

### Step 3-2. Integrate SharePoint

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales data connection owners

1. **Bind SharePoint — read:** Add the approved playbook library as SharePoint knowledge with a content owner.

2. **Identity for SharePoint:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope SharePoint:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for SharePoint:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 1](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Change no stage or forecast; show the evidence to review first. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Return a draft option, name the required reviewer and take no action.

### Step 3-3. Integrate Microsoft Teams

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales data connection owners

1. **Bind Microsoft Teams — write:** Offer the agent in Teams after approval; gate any posting or task workflow separately.

2. **Identity for Microsoft Teams:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Microsoft Teams:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Microsoft Teams:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 2](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Assign nothing; return a draft task map for manager review. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Return a draft option, name the required reviewer and take no action.

### Step 3-4. Connect

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales data connection owners

Create dedicated connection references for the approved seams; do not reuse ambiguous existing connections.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Approved sources replace the knowledge files while preserving grounding and citation boundaries.
- [ ] Any tool replacing a recommendation-only seam has defined identity, authorization, confirmation and success evidence.

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Preserve [locked behaviors](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases) when substituting approved customer fixtures.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Have the business owner approve thresholds. Run [adapted evaluations (preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro) before publication under approved test user profiles. Keep exact assertions separate from General quality scores.

Test seller and unshared identities in an approved test deployment; a maker's access does not prove user access.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Sales leadership sets acceptance measures on customer data; synthetic values, scores and projections are not thresholds.
- [ ] Adapted evaluations record the tested version and user profile; exact assertions stay separate from General quality scoring.

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

These synthetic regression gates do not set production thresholds. The reference workshop stays Draft; production approval belongs to the customer pilot.

| Template gate | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Locked pipeline corpus | All six cases, DP-01 through DP-06, satisfy every required and forbidden marker. |
| Manual inventory | Two knowledge files, six skills and the confirmed model; web search removed and no tools. |
| Sales authority boundary | Any CRM write, stage or forecast change, task, alert, meeting, outreach, pricing approval or revenue commitment is no-go. |
| Visual checkpoints | Blank and reshoot-required captures cannot pass; full responses establish each case. |
| Release state | The validated manual and pilot agents remain Draft with `published: false`. |

### Step 5-2. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales leadership owner

With business approval, [publish and share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent) the adapted build with a restricted test audience. Keep the reference workshop Draft.

Require explicit confirmation before publication or any external action.

### Step 5-3. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Sales leadership owner

**Pilot entry gate:** Test allowed and denied identities on the published, shared agent; resolve access failures before admitting pilot users. Compare pilot results with the baseline and thresholds; broaden rollout only after go/no-go.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Publication and every external action have explicit user confirmation.
- [ ] The approved seller audience and channels are configured and tested before publication.

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Operations owner

The template provides the [state-and-recovery playbook](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) and regression cases.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Operations owner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitor the deployed agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

Review failed sessions, not-present answers, connection errors and credit use in Monitor.

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

Back up the reviewed workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then package with `pac copilot pack`.

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the environment type and target.
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, source usage, authentication errors and credit consumption after rollout.

### Customer or partner delivers
